//NetlifyPreviewSite: Netlify site slug. Every deploy preview for that site (deploy-preview-42--<slug>.netlify.app) is then allowed, without listing each one. Leave empty to allow no previews.
//Resend: Transactional email (password reset). FromAddress must be on a domain verified in Resend, or sends are rejected. Without ApiKey, reset emails are logged as an error and never delivered — the endpoint still returns 204 so it cannot be used to probe for accounts.
//FrontendUrl: Fallback base for reset links when a request carries no Origin header.

Hashing._comment: REQUIRED. Random value, at least 32 chars. Salts the one-way hashes of IP addresses and device identifiers used for the clause 6.3(a) independence check. Without it the app refuses to start, because an unsalted IP hash is reversible by brute force.

CategoryA._comment: POPIA s58(2) standstill. Both default to false when absent. Do not set ProcessingEnabled to true until prior authorisation under s57(1)(b) is granted or the Regulator confirms no assessment will be conducted. See docs/legal/COMPLIANCE-NOTES.md section 2.

Retention._comment: Clause 29 periods, in the units named. The retention worker applies these on each pass.
